text:
incident-bot: [P0] Alert: dedicated-prod-eu-1 p99 latency 9.2s (SLO 5s) · queue_depth=820 (threshold 200) · autoscaler.delay=120s. Paging oncall.

sre-alex: ack. oncall Jamie — you up?

oncall-jamie: i'm on it, grabbing dashboards. p95 ~1.8s, p99 ~9.2s, streaming stalls seen at ~token 512. spike started ~07:42 UTC. region eu-west1.

runtime-jen: looking at node logs — warmup probe failures. new worker nodes register but backend probe returns 503 until KV cache populated.

ml-ops-maria: affected model variants: redwood/rw-7b-quant-v2 and rw-7b-quant-v2-fp16 fallback. load on smaller variants also increased.

support-luke: multiple customers reporting streaming stalls + 504s. created support thread TICKET-12345, pinged CSM Ana.

sre-alex: immediate actions: 1) disable aggressive batching on pool; 2) manual scale +4 nodes; 3) route priority customers to hot path. doing 1 now.

runtime-jen: disabling batching on pool dedicated-prod-eu-1:
```
redwoodctl pools update dedicated-prod-eu-1 --set batching.enabled=false
```

runtime-jen: autoscaler logs:
```
[autoscaler] scale_up request for pool dedicated-prod-eu-1
[autoscaler] awaiting node readiness
[autoscaler] warmup_timeout: KVCache warmup incomplete for model rw-7b-quant-v2 after 60s
[autoscaler] backoff next_retry=30s
```

runtime-jen: warmup is the blocker — nodes marked ready but worker process not accepting streams until KV cache seeded.

sre-alex: manual scale now to +4:
```
redwoodctl pools scale dedicated-prod-eu-1 --add 4
```

incident-bot: manual scale request queued — API acked.

oncall-jamie: starting traffic reroute: move 20% of tiered traffic to hosted fallback us-west1 to reduce pressure.

runtime-jen: applying routing rule:
```
redwoodctl routes update --pool dedicated-prod-eu-1 --split 80,20 --fallback-hosted us-west1
```

sre-alex: after initial changes: queue_depth -> 420 -> 150 after routing + scale, p99 dropped from 9.2s -> ~3.1s. streaming stalls reduced but still present for long requests.

ml-ops-maria: plan: add pre-warm hook on node init to prefill KV cache for hot models. will draft PR to runtime init sequence.

support-luke: notified customers, offered temporary credits and the hosted fallback link. CSM Ana acknowledged :thumbsup:.

sales-csm-ana: thanks — pls loop me into postmortem & customer-facing summary.

sre-alex: notes for postmortem: autoscaler backoff parameters too aggressive; warmup duration under-estimated for quantized models; no pre-warm hook for KV cache; routing policy didn't prefer hot-path for critical customers.

oncall-jamie: handing off: i'm offline for 15m. @sre-alex taking lead. :eyes:

sre-alex: taking it. coordinating with eng-runtime and ml-ops for fix + timeline. creating INC-20098765.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20098765 created and assigned to sre-alex. Severity P0.

sre-alex: monitoring. will post updates in this thread and create postmortem draft after stability window.

runtime-jen: temporary mitigation: will add warmup prefill script to node bootstrap and increase warmup timeout to 120s in autoscaler config.

sre-alex: update 08:02 UTC — p99 = 1.15s, queue_depth = 48, streaming stable. marking incident as mitigated. will keep monitoring 30m.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20098765 mitigated. :white_check_mark:

support-luke: closing customer tickets with notes and links to hosted fallback. will follow up for credits.

sre-alex: postmortem action items: 1) increase autoscaler warmup timeout + metrics, 2) implement pre-warm KV cache in node bootstrap, 3) routing rules to prioritize hot-path for SLO-critical customers, 4) add alert for sustained queue depth > 300. assign owners.

sales-csm-ana: please include customer impact summary and timeline in postmortem. thanks.
